tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description:
Tenderers should not be associated, or have been associated in the
 past, directly or indirectly, with a firm or any of its affiliates which  have been engaged by the Purchaser to provide consulting services for the  preparation of the design, specifications, and other documents to be used  for the procurement of the goods to be purchased under this Invitation of  Tenders.


Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
All Terms & Conditions are uploaded in Tender Document

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: 1. QUALICATION CRITERIA section VII clause 11.2(b) of ITT) the supplier should be a manufacturer who must have manufactured, tested and similar type of machines supplied to KMF Units/any Dairy industries in the last 3 years and list of dairy should be enclosed with performance certificate from the user.

a. The supplier should be manufacturer / authorized dealer /supplier of the machine should be in the field for more than 5 years and should have manufacturing facility in India.b. The Supplier / Company should have supplied and Installed at least 50 Nos of similar type mechanical machines to pack milk to various co-operative societies in India and the list to be enclosed for reference and enquiry.
The Supplier / Company should have a turnover of minimum 2.5 Crores each year for the past consecutive three years.
